title: **🔥🍞 Oven Servant**
description: The sneaky servant keeps multiple tasks burning in the oven, feeding misery and suffering for the Master.

canvas_juggler_subrole_descriptions.ring: 🫓 **Sourdough Hunter** - Accuse innocents of stealing the Master's sourdough

ring.title: 👁️ **Dough Hunter**
ring.description: Igorrr searches for who stole the Master's sourdough... Was it you? Don't lie!
ring.accuse_description: Accuse someone of stealing the sourdough
ring.help_text:
👁️ **Hunter Help**

Igorrr searches for who stole the Master's sourdough. Use `!accuse @user` to accuse someone.

Be careful... false accusations have consequences.
ring.accusation_made: ✅ SSSSS! You accused {user} of stealing the sourdough
ring.accusation_failed: ❌ HUH! I couldn't accuse. The oven distracted me
ring.target_found: 🎯 HEHEJE! {user} stole the sourdough... I smell it!
ring.target_innocent: 😞 {user} didn't steal the sourdough... I'll keep searching
ring.investigation_complete: ✅ The search ended. The sourdough was found by {user}
ring.investigation_failed: ❌ The search failed. The sourdough remains lost
ring.new_investigation: 🔄 New search started. Igorrr is watching...
ring.false_accusation_penalty: ⚖️ **Penalty:** You accused an innocent. The Master will punish you.
ring.correct_accusation_reward: You found the sourdough! The Master will reward you.
ring.accusation_cooldown: ⏰ **Wait:** You must wait {time} before accusing again

dropdown.ring_accuse_description: Accuse a user of stealing the sourdough
dropdown.ring_on_description: Start the search for the stolen sourdough
dropdown.ring_off_description: Stop the search for the stolen sourdough
